steps.content:
2:23 p.m., August 17th, N.F. 113
Secret base of the Garden
No sunlight shines into the base. Coquelic leans against the doorpost, quietly contemplating something with her eyes closed. After a while, she opens her eyes and stretches dramatically.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Yawn... that trip was exhausting. My back hurts from sleeping...

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Garofano, I want to take a bath... with roses this time. I want the tea to be rose too, as well as the snacks...

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: ...Oh, I forgot. She hasn't woken up yet.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Fine, Sumire can do it. Are you in a better mood now? If so, can you give me a massage?

steps.speaker: Sumire
steps.content: As you wish.
Warm spring water pours into the square bath. Fresh, bright red rose petals float on the surface. Coquelic soaks inside, happily enjoying Sumire's service.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Ahhh... That feels much better...

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: How's Garofano?

steps.speaker: Sumire
steps.content: She's still deep asleep, but thanks to your help extracting the filth from her body, she is no longer producing any contamination.

steps.speaker: Sumire
steps.content: Some newbies are taking care of her. She should be waking up soon.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: That's good then.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Add another rule to the Garden's manual: Don't blindly listen to the employer's orders to use weird powers. Always rely on yourself, or ask the Mentor for help.

steps.speaker: Sumire
steps.content: All right. I'll add it as rule number 73.

steps.speaker: Sumire
steps.content: As for Thistle...

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: She brought it upon herself.
Silence.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: She repeatedly disobeyed my orders and acted on her own, and fell for such an obvious trap. If I hadn't taken precautions in advance, she might have leaked all kinds of information.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: I won't go save her again. Let her suffer the consequences of her actions.
After another long silence, Coquelic reluctantly continues the conversation.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Okay, okay... She's probably with the psychologist at the 9th Agency right now. I set a reverse-psychology trap for her. They're going to be busy for a few days.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: It's safer for her to be locked up in the 9th Agency than to be running around the Garden. That <color=#fb9259>Silver Spider</color> never saw eye-to-eye with Hush, and wouldn't hand her over.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: She'll probably end up in your Bureau. That's quite suitable for her. She has completed her revenge. Before she figures out what she wants, she should just calm down for a bit.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: I didn't say I despise her. Newbies don't know the rules and break them, but she beats all of you in at least one aspect.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: She does everything for herself, and wouldn't sacrifice herself for others or let herself be taken advantage of. From this perspective, she's the most like me. She makes me less worried about her than the rest of you.

steps.speaker: Sumire
steps.content: As long as she's okay.
Silence.

steps.speaker: She grips your wrist tightly, her eyes gleaming with wild excitement.
steps.content: Mentor, you have never acted in such a high-profile way before. You've attracted so much attention this time. Is that okay?
Coquelic laughs. Only Sumire would ask something like this. She's usually soft and shy, but becomes very direct at critical times. She tilts her head up and playfully flicks Sumire's chin.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: If you're afraid of being implicated, just hide well. I don't need your help anyway.

steps.speaker: Sumire
steps.content: No, I've been prepared to meet my fate since the day I joined the Garden. And you are the strongest one there is. I don't believe that anyone can defeat you.

steps.speaker: Sumire
steps.content: It's just you've always hated the conflict between the Underground and Paradeisos. You even chose this secluded place as a result.

steps.speaker: Sumire
steps.content: Is there a deeper reason for your involvement this time?

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: No. I was just feeling sluggish in spring, and didn't want to move or bother with them. Now that summer is here, it's time for the flowers to bloom and for me to take action.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Those guys from HUSH have been annoying me for a long time. I can't stand flies buzzing around my Garden. That's all there is to it.
As she speaks, she brushes aside Sumire's long black hair, hooks her neck to pull her in closer, then gazes into her eyes.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Why are you asking this? You usually don't care about these things. You've always wanted to leave the Garden. This is the first time you've come back to the Garden to find me. And those who come to the Garden to find me have only one reason...

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: How's your <color=#fb9259>vengeance</color> coming along? For your kind and gentle Chief who ended up killed? Need my help?
The sudden change of topic makes Sumire freeze.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: You left the MBCC for this, right? You wouldn't possibly let those who hurt him off the hook.
steps.female_content: You left the MBCC for this, right? You wouldn't possibly let those who hurt her off the hook.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Who did you go kill in West District? Rustfire, the Executive Committee... who else? Those high-ranking execs from Nirvana? Can you find the chance to strike?

steps.speaker: Sumire
steps.content: Yes. Thanks to you diverting their attention with your recent activity, I've had the opportunity to get close to them.

steps.speaker: Sumire
steps.content: To avoid interfering with your actions, I've been very discreet. No one will discover that this is the work of the Garden.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Ha, well done. There's no news of this anywhere. You're truly my best student.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: So, has your anger subsided? You feel better? You've avenged so many wrongs, and should feel happier by now. How about giving me a smile?

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: I haven't seen you smile in a long time. Seeing you so bitter puts me in a bad mood, too.

steps.speaker: Trust them to do their job. There isn't much we can do.
steps.content: I've eliminated many Rustfire thugs, Executive Officers, and Nirvana scum. I've killed so many enemies, yet I don't feel like I've completed my vengeance.

steps.speaker: Sumire
steps.content: ...There are simply too many of them to kill. There are too many bastards who are responsible for his pain. I can't kill them all. They don't even know what they've done!
steps.female_content: ...There are simply too many of them to kill. There are too many bastards who are responsible for her pain. I can't kill them all. They don't even know what they've done!

steps.content: She bends over in agony, burying her face in her hands.

steps.speaker: Sumire
steps.content: You once said that the joy from vengeance would liberate me from hatred, but this hatred is endless. It's blurring and wearing me down... I have no way of freeing myself.

steps.speaker: Sumire
steps.content: You've also been dealing with endless hatred. How do you cope? How do you stop your heart from becoming numb?

steps.speaker: Sumire
steps.content: Or is this just the price I have to pay for giving away my heart? Because after losing him, I can never find a replacement.
steps.female_content: Or is this just the price I have to pay for giving away my heart? Because after losing her, I can never find a replacement.

steps.speaker: Sumire
steps.content: Is that why you told us to only love ourselves forever?

steps.speaker: Sumire
steps.content: I don't know what to do, I... need your guidance.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: ...You're living well and suddenly someone stabs you, but you can't find the culprit. You can only fumble blindly in the dark.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: This is not vengeance. You're just being driven by pain. Fate has hurt you. You need to first find out who's the bastard that did it, then figure out how to deal with him.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: If you can't find the culprit, just let it go for now. Maybe in a couple of days, he'll come to you head-on.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: As for how to punish bad "fate"... There are other ways aside from an eye for an eye.

steps.speaker: Sumire
steps.content: You mean...?

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: If that idiot is still alive, find him and take him back. There's nothing wrong with liking someone. Instead of giving your heart away, why don't you get him to give his heart to you and hold on to it tightly?
steps.female_content: If that idiot is still alive, find her and take her back. There's nothing wrong with liking someone. Instead of giving your heart away, why don't you get her to give her heart to you and hold on to it tightly?

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: I would like to go find him if I had the chance. I want to see how that silly boy is doing. But...
steps.female_content: I would like to go find her if I had the chance. I want to see how that silly girl is doing. But...

steps.content: She smooths Sumire's hair and flashes a rare, gentle smile.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Listen up. This is the last time I'm teaching you. I won't say it again.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: You are all flowers that I've picked. You all more or less have some of my qualities to have been able to join my Garden. The more beautiful the flower, the more bugs it attracts, and you all know how much these self-righteous bugs love to trample on flowers.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Flowers are indeed fragile. The more beautiful they are, the likelier they are to bend and wither with a slight blow. Just like how pitiful all of you were when you first came to me.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: But it's okay, let them come. You might appear weak, but you're stronger than you think.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: If you're crushed, you'll bloom again next year. If you're burned, you'll sprout new buds from the ashes. Fate can break you, but it can never destroy you... as long as you keep your roots firmly in the ground.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Don't drift with the current. Don't let fate push you around. Don't let external things lead you astray.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Your lives are your own. Don't listen to anyone but me.
She lets go of her hands and gets up. The sound of splashing water echoes all around.

steps.speaker: Sumire
steps.content: I will, but Mentor, what did you mean just now? Why did you say it's "the last time"?

steps.speaker: Sumire
steps.content: You've been fighting alone for the past two months. Everyone is very worried about you.

steps.speaker: Sumire
steps.content: Do you have any other arrangements? Please tell me. Your health...

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Ah, I can't stand it. I feel bad all over. Call everyone over for a massage. Consider it my birthday celebration in advance.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Wishing for beauty, joy and wishes coming true today and every day.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Think about how to make your Mentor happy. Today's task is to give me the best day ever!
She had the best day ever indeed.
After that night, Coquelic leaves a stack of handwritten instructions, punishes each assassin with solitary confinement, and then disappears from her Garden.
